open_questions: Not run and not seen by eye: no tests, no window. The owner should fly the Flagship and check every beat.
The rush sting and clamp tick are tiny synthesized tones (Juice.TONES), no audio files. The owner may want real sounds later.
All effects on the map freeze while paused, so a rush delivery made inside the (paused) dock sheet shows its ring when the clock runs again; the sting and label pop play at once.
handoff: Flight and dock juice built, all in the four named scripts. pathfinder_view.gd watches the Flagship each frame (no edits to main.gd or pathfinder.gd) and starts: selection ring pop and nose swing and engine flare on an accepted order, departure puff on leaving, bright boost burst plus a stretched, brighter, wider trail (ship_trail.gd stretch/glow, eased on game time), a docking ring that closes on the ship then a clamp pulse and tick on arrival, a slow pulse on the target marker (own material) while flying, and on a finished rush order a double ring on the world, a label pop and a sting (it connects to flight.delivered and compares gigs.rush_done next frame). A fixed pool of 8 rings and 3 flares is reused; nothing allocates per frame; idle cost is a few compares. Motion <= 0 stops everything and resets the ship yaw offset and ring scale. dock_sheet.gd: the card settles in (Juice.enter), a Credits row counts up or down with a signed float, and a trade streams small crates between the hold line and the world name. juice.gd: tone_wav, play_tone, crates, float_text. Tuning: 19 new data/balance.json flight_juice_* keys, all PLACEHOLDERS, noted in the source note (FX_FALLBACK and JUICE_FALLBACK mirror them only for a missing key). Text: new id LBL_DOCK_CASH (story/screens.md, build_story.py run). No save fields. Hooks added to other files: none.
